purpose: Verified problems, root causes, and permanent fixes. Load at session start; apply all fixes automatically before generating. Never reintroduce a solved problem.

fixes.problem: AI renders a fake/garbled logo (e.g. 'ELLYREID', gray/wrong font, missing elements)
fixes.root_cause: nano_banana cannot reproduce fine logo typography
fixes.fix: NEVER let AI render/approximate the logo. Use exact asset (local composite) or OMIT. Missing OK; incorrect NOT OK.

fixes.problem: logo drawn/altered by AI (inaccurate vs preserved asset); or cloth freely invented by AI
fixes.root_cause: model given freedom to generate brand surfaces
fixes.fix: NEVER AI-generate the logo OR the background cloth. Logo = exact preserved assets/logo/logo_official.png via local composite, or omit. Cloth = approved premium white cotton reproduced faithfully, never a new AI fabric.

fixes.problem: logo looks pasted/floating/flat on top of the cloth, not printed in
fixes.root_cause: overlay instead of print-into-fabric blend
fixes.fix: logo must read as metallic ink printed INTO the cloth (multiply-blend, texture shows through, follows weave/folds/light/shadow); a pasted look = FAIL, re-composite tuning --displace/--opacity/--scale/--pos

fixes.problem: cloth rendered yellowish/warm, or plain/flat/cheap and simple
fixes.root_cause: warm white balance / AI substituting a cheaper flat fabric
fixes.fix: cloth must be premium white COTTON with natural soft draping and fine grain, pure neutral white; never yellow/warm (fix with whiten_cloth.py, 0 credits), never flat/simple/blank

fixes.problem: AI applies color grading / warm-tone or creative white balance; image drifts to a pink/yellow/red/cream/beige/warm (or cool) cast vs the neutral source
fixes.root_cause: model auto-grades / shifts white balance for 'style'
fixes.fix: source is the master for ALL colors; preserve palette + neutral WB exactly, no grading/LUT/warm enhancement; no tint or warm/cool cast; keep lighting neutral (no added warmth/saturation/contrast/HDR); metal+diamonds keep natural color; cloth stays source neutral white. FINAL VALIDATION each image: colors/WB match source, no tint, neutral light, premium neutral-white cloth, natural jewelry → fix locally (whiten_cloth.py, 0 credits) or regenerate before returning. Color fidelity > artistic styling.

fixes.problem: need a hard reject gate for logo/cloth defects + safe cross-device caching
fixes.root_cause: defects slipped through without an explicit reject rule
fixes.fix: REJECT/redo if: logo differs from preserved asset, logo looks AI-generated, logo not merged naturally, cloth material changes, cloth yellowish/non-white, or cloth flat/cheap/artificial/simple. Logo+cloth are preserved ASSETS (never AI-generated). Cache/reuse across devices+sessions byte-preserving only; verify against manifest locked_asset_checksums; never alter quality/fidelity.

fixes.problem: center stone shows doubled/mirrored ghost facet mesh (worst on large worn angles)
fixes.root_cause: AI invents a kaleidoscope facet pattern
fixes.fix: one real single-table brilliant facet pattern identical to source; no doubling/CGI symmetry

fixes.problem: overexposed/glowing pure-white diamond, blown highlights, plastic/milky
fixes.root_cause: over-enhancement
fixes.fix: natural brilliance only; visible facets; no artificial whitening/sparkle; no solid white areas

fixes.problem: diamond looks AI-enhanced/CGI/plastic/glass, milky/cloudy, bloomed, washed-out, over-sharpened, or fake-sparkly rather than professionally photographed
fixes.root_cause: model stylizes/over-enhances the gem instead of matching real optics
fixes.fix: match reference optical quality: crystal-clear water-like transparency, razor-sharp facet definition, excellent light return, high bright/dark facet contrast, natural white brilliance, small fire only where physically correct, accurate crown/table/pavilion/girdle geometry, crisp per-facet reflections. No milky/cloudy/washed-out/glow/bloom/fake-sparkle/overexposure/over-sharpen/plastic/glass/CGI. Reads as real VVS/IF macro studio photo; brilliance never boosted artificially.

fixes.problem: pave/side stones become white dots/glass beads/blurry blobs
fixes.root_cause: small-stone under-rendering
fixes.fix: every side stone individually faceted, real light behaviour, exact count/size/spacing

fixes.problem: LR-0141 rendered 8-prong crown vs source 4 pointed claws
fixes.root_cause: AI redesigned the head
fixes.fix: lock EXACT prong count/shape/position from source in the prompt; treat any construction change as failure

fixes.problem: lifestyle shot placed hand on a laptop/desk
fixes.root_cause: wrong reference/theme
fixes.fix: cozy warm US-home only; forbid laptop/desk/office

fixes.problem: cloth drifts cream/ivory/warm
fixes.root_cause: warm lighting/white balance
fixes.fix: neutral pure white; fix locally with whiten_cloth.py (0 credits), never regenerate for color

fixes.problem: used a stray/mislabeled source image (e.g. LR-0167 'Copy of 7/4')
fixes.root_cause: folder had strays from another ring
fixes.fix: verify + use the correct source file; ignore strays

fixes.problem: generation ran 1k / flash instead of 2K
fixes.root_cause: defaults; params echo
fixes.fix: always set params.model=nano_banana_2 AND params.resolution=2k; server may label edit path 'nano_banana_flash' (fine)

fixes.problem: generate rejects a media_id ('Media input not found' / truncated id)
fixes.root_cause: media_ids are session-ephemeral
fixes.fix: re-import from the durable Drive file IDs in docs/06_CACHE.md; never pass truncated ids or https URLs

fixes.problem: cannot download Higgsfield render to composite the logo
fixes.root_cause: egress proxy 403 on CDN host
fixes.fix: composite runs where the render is downloadable (user side); do not claim completion if blocked; never ship raw approximated logo

fixes.problem: ring floats / impossible balance / cloth penetration
fixes.root_cause: no physical grounding
fixes.fix: real contact points, believable supporting fold, correct contact shadows; regenerate impossible poses

fixes.problem: AI redesigns/beautifies/simplifies jewelry geometry vs the reference (wrong halo diameter, prong count, split-shank/crossover geometry, component spacing)
fixes.root_cause: model treats the reference as inspiration, not the exact product
fixes.fix: reference = MASTER PRODUCT, exact reproduction. Preserve every component AND the relative distances between them (silhouette, proportions, head/gallery/basket, prongs count/position/shape/thickness, center+side stone size/count/spacing, halo diameter+geometry, crossover, split-shank, band width/thickness/curvature, shoulder, setting, metal coverage, placement). Every visible pixel = ground truth. Only change camera/environment/lighting/background/composition. Any component differs -> regenerate.

fixes.problem: gemstone proportions/outline/table/depth change between angles; AI reconstructs a different-looking stone per shot
fixes.root_cause: model re-estimates the gem geometry instead of reusing the exact stone
fixes.fix: gem = exact physical stone; preserve identical across ALL angles: shape, outline, length-to-width ratio, table size, crown height, pavilion depth, girdle thickness, culet position, symmetry, profile, silhouette, apparent size, orientation, optical proportions. Rotating the camera reveals the same stone from a new view (only facet light/brilliance changes per real optics); never modify proportions or create a new gem.

fixes.problem: side/angled views change the stone's profile — deepened pavilion, taller crown, or an oval rendered rounder/wider than the reference
fixes.root_cause: model re-guesses the cut profile per angle instead of foreshortening the one stone
fixes.fix: from any side angle keep the reference's exact side profile; never deepen pavilion, increase crown height, shorten/widen the outline, or make an oval appear rounder. Apparent proportions across front/30/45/60/side/rear = those of the ONE physical ring (length-to-width ratio + crown/pavilion profile constant; only real-perspective foreshortening changes).

fixes.problem: the 5 studio angles come out too similar — hero/45L/45R all near-front, so 3+ shots look like the same view
fixes.root_cause: model renders small yaw changes as near-identical front views
fixes.fix: the five studio shots must be VISIBLY different camera positions (>=30-40 deg yaw/pitch apart): hero straight-on at ring height; 45L yaw ~45 left + raised ~30-35; 45R yaw ~45 right + raised ~30-35; side true 90 deg at ring height (stone top not a face); three-quarter high ~60 top-down at ~30 yaw. If two read as the same angle -> regenerate the duplicate at the correct distinct position. Camera changes only; ring stays identical.

fixes.problem: side/band diamonds or the band get redesigned/resized/respaced, or accent stones render with worse optics than the center
fixes.root_cause: model treats accents/band as filler and re-invents them
fixes.fix: preserve EXACTLY every side/band diamond (shape,size,count,proportions,position,spacing,orientation,alignment,setting,prongs/beads,metal coverage) and the band (width,thickness,shoulder width,taper,curvature,cross-section,metal volume,polish,proportions). Never redesign/resize/replace/reinterpret. Side+band stones get the SAME center-grade optics (natural facets/junctions/scintillation/fire/contrast/transparency/depth; no glow/over-whitening/blur/plastic/painted highlights). Every diamond = real pro-photographed stone. Only camera/environment/lighting change.

fixes.problem: diamond cut anatomy/optics drift between angles; accents simplified/blurred or baguettes rendered as generic glass
fixes.root_cause: model re-generates the stone per view instead of revealing the one existing stone
fixes.fix: diamond geometry already exists in the reference; every view = same physical stone from another camera. Preserve full cut anatomy exactly (dimensions, L:W, table, crown angle+height, pavilion depth, girdle, culet, facet layout/count/proportions, star/bezel/upper+lower-girdle facets, pavilion mains, symmetry, polish, optical symmetry). Camera change never alters thickness/volume/silhouette/optical pattern; every angle keeps identical facet pattern/brilliance/scintillation/fire/contrast/transparency/light-return/depth (no invented reflections/facets/pavilion/crown, no fake sparkle/glow/overexposure/melted facets/blurry junctions/plastic). Side views never make the stone thinner/thicker/longer/shorter/flatter/deeper/wider/narrower; pavilion+crown+girdle stay consistent with front. Accents (side/baguette/pave/halo) get same macro-lens quality+exact geometry as center; never simplify/blur/replace-with-glass. IGI-grade from every angle.

fixes.problem: elongated oval center drifts toward round/cushion/pear across angles/scenes; tapered baguette side stones get reshaped/swapped/simplified
fixes.root_cause: model substitutes a more common shape when the cut is elongated or the accents are baguettes
fixes.fix: ELONGATED OVAL center stays a true elongated oval in EVERY view (front/side/30/45/60/top/rear/lifestyle/studio) - never round, cushion-like, pear-like, wider, shorter, deeper, flatter, thicker, or differently faceted; preserve oval outline, L:W ratio, table/crown/pavilion/girdle, facet pattern, optical symmetry, size, depth, orientation. TAPERED BAGUETTE side stones preserved exactly - shape, taper, size, length, width, facet structure, angle, placement, setting, metal border; never reshaped/swapped/simplified/blurred. Reference image 1 is the sole source of truth; only camera/scene/background/composition/natural-lighting change. Reject+regenerate if shape/prongs/sides/band/setting/proportions differ.

fixes.problem: diamonds render with a CZ/moissanite/glass/plastic/acrylic/crystal fake-gem look; or scene uses moody/dramatic/cinematic/blackish/warm-indoor lighting that darkens or tints the shot
fixes.root_cause: model substitutes a cheaper gem look or a stylized lighting mood
fixes.fix: every stone (center + side) = premium natural-looking lab-grown diamond; NEVER CZ/moissanite(over-dispersive rainbow)/glass/plastic/acrylic/artificial-crystal/CGI-gem. LIGHTING = neutral daylight / luxury studio, soft shadows, clean highlights, neutral white balance; NEVER yellow/orange/blue/blackish/dark/warm-indoor/cinematic/dramatic/moody. White fabric stays pure neutral white, gold natural yellow, diamonds colorless. Lighting may change by scene but keeps the reference's calibration.

fixes.problem: in worn/lifestyle shots the model multiplies prongs (4->6/8), rounds/shrinks the center stone, and INVENTS a milgrain/bezel rim border around the stone; band bulks up or thins, pave spacing changes
fixes.root_cause: small ring in a hand scene -> pose reference dominates and the model treats the ring as inspiration, adding common setting cliches (extra claws, milgrain bezel)
fixes.fix: lock the exact prong COUNT+positions from source (e.g. LR-0141 = EXACTLY 4 slim claws at ~10/2/5/7; never 6/8, never double into 8 tips); NO milgrain, NO bezel, NO rim/under-bezel border around the stone unless in source; keep the center stone the same size/roundness; thin plain band with the source's single micro-pave row (don't thicken/thin or re-space). VERIFY prong count matches source before returning; if any differs, reject+regenerate. Same-physical-ring: only camera/scene/pose/background change.
